mapper.select: select a.task_id, a.instance_id, a.device_mete_id, a.device_id, a.custom_id, a.point_task_id, d.cruise_type as point_type, b.device_type, c.mete_type, b.up_region_id as region_id from t_cruise_task_attr a left join t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id left join t_std_devicemete c on a.device_mete_id = c.device_mete_id left join t_cruise_point_instance d on a.instance_id = d.instance_id

select a.task_id, ifnull(a.task_code, a.task_id), a.task_name, a.area_id, a.c_type as task_type, b.run_execute as execute_type, '3' as task_level, a.c_state as task_state, a.modify_state, a.task_count, a.task_wait, a.check_user, a.check_date, a.weather, a.create_time, DATE_ADD(a.execute_time, interval 146 minute) as end_time, a.execute_time, b.task_abnormal, '0' as remark from t_cruise_result a left join t_cruise_task_result b on a.task_result_id = b.task_result_id

select c.task_id, a.device_id, a.device_name, d.device_mete_id, d.custom_id, a.instance_id, a.instance_name, d.cruise_id, d.cruise_name, a.cruise_time, a.cruise_status, b.cruise_type, ( CASE WHEN b.cruise_type=228 THEN b2.robot_id WHEN b.cruise_type=229 or b.cruise_type=230 THEN d2.camera_id END ) as cruise_device_id, ( CASE WHEN b.cruise_type=228 THEN b2.robot_name WHEN b.cruise_type=229 or b.cruise_type=230 THEN d2.camera_name END ) as cruise_device_name, b.result_num as result_desc, b.modify_num, d.unit, b.picpath, b.confirm_pic_path, b.pic_path_anl, b.person_check, b.origpic, b.orig_confirm_pic_path, b.orig_pic_anl, b.cruise_abnormal, b.evaluation_state, b.identify_state, b.identify_result, b.createtime, b.remark, b.check_user, b.check_date, b.is_warn, b.cruise_result, b.fir_name, b.fir_date, b.result_pic, b.points, b.voice_path from t_cruise_task_result_detail a left join t_cruise_data_result b on a.cruise_result_id = b.cruise_result_id left join t_cruise_task_result c on a.task_result_id = c.task_result_id left join t_cruise_point_instance d on a.instance_id = d.instance_id left join t_robot_inspection b1 on d.cruise_id=b1.inspection_id and b.cruise_type=228 left join t_robot_info b2 ON b1.robot_id=b2.robot_id left join t_camera_preset d1 on d.cruise_id=d1.preset_id and (b.cruise_type=229 or b.cruise_type=230) left join t_camera_info d2 ON d1.camera_id=d2.camera_id
